'''Base Prime''' was a research installation erected by [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]] on a [[Unidentified monolith|monolith of unknown origin]] inside the [[Bubble of the Lost/Legends|Bubble of the Lost]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It housed the laboratories where the brothers conducted their experiments. It was destroyed in [[45 ABY]] after [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Ben Skywalker]], [[Omad Kaeg]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] successfully rescued [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the Qrephs.
